title: Cloud Computing: What Investors May Be Missing
excerpt: A closer look at Cloud Computing and the assumptions shaping the current debate.
content:
Interest in Cloud Computing continues to grow, but the key issue is understanding the forces behind the trend rather than simply following the latest reaction.

A closer examination shows that opportunities and risks often exist at the same time. The outcome depends on which assumptions prove accurate.
